decision.reasoning_trace: The browsing session involved filtering through several non-backpack items (such as camping food, drill bits, and tent stakes) to find quality gear. I selected a consideration set of highly-rated tactical and hydration backpacks, focusing on products with at least a 4.6 rating and substantial review volume. The QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) was chosen as the final purchase because it offers a large capacity, excellent value for money ($39.99), and maintains a 4.7-star rating with over 6,000 reviews, with specific praise for its durability and design compared to more expensive models.
